name: Hamidur Rahman
contribution: Hamidur Rahman was a freedom fighter who led an assault on Pakistani positions at the Dhalai frontier outpost in October 1971 and was killed in close combat.
context: The Dhalai operation formed part of the fighting along the Tripura-Sylhet frontier, where Mukti Bahini units attacked fortified positions and tried to open routes through the border region.
impact: His action is remembered through Bangladesh's highest military honour, Bir Sreshtho, and represents the courage demanded by direct assaults during the Liberation War.
highlight: He advanced first in a high-risk bunker assault and fell in action.
